title: (Pwn2Own) Phoenix Contact CHARX SEC-3150 OCPP Missing Authentication for Critical Function Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to modify configuration on affected installations of Phoenix Contact CHARX SEC-3150 devices. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.
The specific flaw exists within the export-import endpoint. The issue results from the lack of authentication prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system.
addtionnal_details: Fixed in firmware v1.9.1, available by Aug 12, 2026.https://certvde.com/en/advisories/VDE-2026-008/
